messages.subject: Indigo royalties — quick question (not Harburn)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah — separate from the Harburn dispute: Aerelon have queried the minimum annual royalty under the Project Indigo licence again. Can James or Elena confirm the £1.05m figure and the audit-rights clause when there's a moment? No rush.

Henry
